question: What determines the rate of aging and why do longevity interventions show contradictory results?
description: Investigating the fundamental aging mechanisms and intervention paradoxes
key_contradictions: Why do some mTOR inhibitors extend lifespan while others shorten it?
Intermittent fasting benefits contrast with caloric restriction timing effects
Longevity genes show opposite effects in prokaryotes vs mammals

benchmark_hypotheses.statement: The paradox of mTOR inhibition outcomes is mediated by a threshold-dependent compensatory stress response that only activates when inhibition exceeds a critical level relative to age-related proteostasis decline.

What if intermittent fasting benefits are not due to metabolic switching but to a circadian reprogramming of stem cell niches that enhances regenerative capacity through an unknown clock-metabolism coupling mechanism?

The opposite effects of longevity genes across species is mediated by an evolutionary trade-off where the same pathway has been repurposed from stress resistance in simple organisms to tissue maintenance in complex organisms through a hidden regulatory switch.
